BEFORE YOUR CONVERSATION

A few things
to know.

Where should I request a financial-services appointment?+

Use Greg’s official WFG profile to see current appointment options and contact information. The button above opens that profile in a new tab.

Can Greg help in my state?+

Service and product availability depend on location, licensing and the applicable organization. Confirm your location and needs directly before proceeding.

Should I share financial documents through this website?+

Please do not include account numbers, Social Security numbers, medical information or other sensitive details in a general inquiry. Ask Greg for the appropriate channel.

Can I ask about a financial-services business opportunity?+

Greg’s official WFG profile includes information about the business opportunity. Review those details and applicable disclosures on the official platform.

Financial services are separate from Denizard Consulting and community coaching. Insurance products and availability are subject to licensing, location and applicable company requirements. See Greg’s official WFG profile for the relevant entity information and disclosures. This site does not provide tax or legal advice.
